logging.description: Logging domains and levels (e.g., 'DEBUG', 'INFO'). Each item defines a logging domain (e.g., 'core', 'dhcp', 'nm') and its verbosity level.

keyfile.unmanaged.description: List of interface names (e.g., 'eth0', 'wlan0') that NetworkManager should NOT manage.

dns.description: DNS plugins to use. Common values: 'dnsmasq' (default), 'systemd-resolved', 'none'.

systemd_resolved.description: Whether to integrate with systemd-resolved for DNS resolution.

no_auto_default.description: If true, NetworkManager will NOT automatically create default wired (Ethernet) connections on boot.
